basics.name: Martin Omondo
basics.label: Full-Stack Web & Android Developer
basics.summary:
Year 2 BSIT student at Karatina University and a full-stack developer who
builds real software, not tutorials. Completed full-stack web development
training at Eldohub (August 2025), then kept building — 65+ repos and
projects, several worked on with other developers. Delivered a paid client
project (a React fundraising app, PERN stack) from idea to deployment.

Strengths: full-stack web development (React, Express, Node, PostgreSQL/MySQL)
and Android development (Kotlin), with real payment integrations (M-Pesa,
Paystack, PayPal, Stripe) and deployments on Vercel, Render and AlwaysData.

I don't claim years of experience I don't have — I claim shipped projects,
working payments, and the discipline to deliver on time.

work.name: Self-employed
work.summary:
Building my portfolio and client pipeline toward full-time software
engineering. Honest about experience level, disciplined with deadlines,
ships small and often.
highlights: Delivered first paid client project (React fundraising app, PERN stack)
Built and maintain 7 portfolio projects across web, Android, and desktop
65+ repos of self-driven projects incl. payment integrations

education.area: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT)

projects.name: FinMate — Role-Based Finance System
projects.description: Full finance platform for individuals and teams: expenses, budgets, savings, planned purchases. 5-role RBAC with a permission matrix and guarded routes. Deployed on Vercel; auto-creates schema + seeds roles on boot.

projects.name: EDU LMS — Learning Management System
projects.description: 5-role LMS: courses, assignments, grading, attendance, fee payments, audit logging. Security-first: helmet CSP, rate-limited auth, validated inputs — with a passing Jest + supertest suite.

projects.name: Cdely — Multi-Vendor E-Commerce & Delivery
projects.description: 4-role platform (customer/seller/rider/admin) with a 30+ table schema. Checkout with M-Pesa (Daraja STK), Paystack, and cash-on-delivery, plus real-time order tracking.

projects.name: AgroLink — Agricultural Marketplace
projects.description: Farmer/buyer/supplier marketplace with product listings, orders, reviews. Real-time buyer–seller chat via Socket.io, persisted to MySQL.

projects.name: Fundraising App — Paid Client Work
projects.description: Built with a friend for a real client: user accounts, campaign pages, donations, and an admin view. My first paid project and proof of taking an idea from zero to deployed.

projects.name: LiteLink — PC ↔ Android Companion Suite
projects.description: Self-hosted KDE-Connect-style bridge: screen mirroring, notifications, folder sync, clipboard, M-Pesa tracker. 86 tracked features, no cloud.

projects.name: FSPEDX — Android Game Performance Booster
projects.description: 30+ working features for budget phones: RAM/thermal tuning, FPS overlays, touch heatmaps, session replay.
